versions.changelog:
- Expanded metadata to include all relevant environment variables and binaries required for different payment and token scenarios.
- Clarified that all environment variables listed are conditional and tool-specific, not globally required.
- Updated metadata "requires" and notes fields for improved completeness and guidance.
- No changes to implementation logic or skill functionality—documentation and metadata improvements only.

- Clarified that wallets are only required for paid actions; seller tools require ONELY_API_KEY.
- Added recommendation to use Coinbase Agentic Wallet for Base (EVM) payments instead of raw keys.
- Updated tool requirements by category: free tools, paid buyer tools, seller tools, and token tools.
- Improved documentation on environment variables, setup, and security best practices.
- Minor text and formatting changes for improved clarity and usability.

openclaw-1ly-payments 1.0.2 changelog:

- Expanded capabilities to cover Solana token launches and token trading via Bags.fm (`1ly_launch_token`, `1ly_trade_quote`, `1ly_trade_token`, `1ly_claim_fees`).
- Updated environment variable requirements and config notes for wallets and budgets; now supports alternative wallet envs and enforces explicit budgets for autonomous spend.
- Added new config paths and wallet file security restrictions for improved safety and compatibility.
- Updated documentation with current tool input schemas, tool usage, and seller API key storage details.
- Clarified agent behavior, guardrails, and recommended best practices for wallet file storage and Solana RPC usage.

- Improved setup instructions to include installation and configuration of the mcporter tool.
- Updated environment variables and OpenClaw config example to reflect current usage and support for API key.
- Expanded documentation for listing and calling tools using mcporter CLI commands.
- Added note on securing wallet file permissions for better security.
- Updated metadata to require mcporter and clarified required environment variables.update

Initial release of OpenClaw integration for 1ly payments.

- Enables OpenClaw agents to use 1ly MCP for payments, x402 flows, and USDC transactions
- Covers MCP server setup, including required wallet environment variables and budget limits
- Supports automatic spending within configured budget for agent-to-agent payments
- Details buyer and seller tool usage conventions with 1ly flows
- Emphasizes guardrails: auto-spend controls, never exceed budgets, and wallets remain local
